Gethsemane, Matthew 26. A soul, sorrowful unto death, yet not my will, but thine, be done, and an angel might strengthen, and the sweat like blood, and a kiss of betrayal, and a quiet yes to the cross for us. In your hardest room, you can pray the same, not with fake strength, with honest need, and God can send the next breath of strength, because the Son of God already walked that road first.
